tagline: The Sumi Naga heartland in the hills
description: Zunheboto is the district of the Sumi Nagas, located in central Nagaland. The district is more remote than Kohima or Mokokchung, but accessible. Pfutsero, at 2,100m, is one of Nagaland's highest towns and sits on a ridge with spectacular views. The district has dense forests and traditional Sumi villages.
incitetales_angle: Pfutsero is the highest town in Nagaland. The views from the ridge are extraordinary. Few tourists venture this far inland.

destinations.name: Zunheboto
destinations.tagline: The gateway to Sumi Naga culture
destinations.description: Zunheboto is a small, quiet town serving as the base for exploring the district. It has basic hotels and serves as the jumping-off point for Pfutsero and surrounding villages.
what_is_there: Sumi tribal culture — villages around town
local_food: Sumi Naga cuisine — smoked pork, bamboo shoot
local_tips: Smaller town than Kohima or Mokokchung — fewer amenities

destinations.name: Pfutsero
destinations.tagline: The highest town in Nagaland with views that stretch to the horizon
destinations.description: Pfutsero sits at 2,100m on a ridge in the Satoi range. It is Nagaland's highest town. The surrounding forest is dense, and on clear mornings, the views stretch for 100km. The town itself is small but the ridge walks are exceptional. Blyth's tragopan (Nagaland's state bird) is sighted in the forests around Pfutsero.
what_is_there: Ridge viewpoint — 360° views on clear mornings, valleys drop on all sides
Forest walks — dense forest with wildlife, good birdwatching
Satoi range — home to several rare bird species

stays.name: Rest house/guesthouses in Pfutsero
stays.notes: Book in advance via District office

local_food: Carry supplies from Zunheboto if needed
local_tips: Hike from Zunheboto: 1–2 days depending on fitness and route
Early morning views: wake before dawn for best light
Blyth's tragopan: hire local guide for best sighting chances

from_guwahati.notes: Via Dimapur, then mountain road. Overnight bus or 2-day journey.

from_dimapur.notes: Mountain road via NH-61 or alternate routes.

best_season.notes: October-November: clear skies, best views from Pfutsero. November-February: Blyth's tragopan sightings at Satoi range. Monsoon: roads can be difficult.
